fact: The Instituto Nacional de Saúde Pública (INASA) with the Ministry of Public Health published the Anuário Estatístico de 2022, a health statistics yearbook of health indicators (the health-sector information system of MINSAP and INASA) financed by the World Bank with WHO technical support; it is the second yearbook (edition 2022, published May 2024).
title: Anuário estatístico de 2022
